findings: Every named ancestor and traversed directory is opened O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW and checked against held/name metadata. Directory entries are never followed by the recursive walk.

Symlink target expansion retains parent steps until expansion and restarts from held root with the correct remaining prefix; a parent step at root is rejected before lookup. Absolute redirects must remain under the exact charged root.

Forty-link-hop,64-directory-depth,8192-entry and128MiB apparent-size bounds are finite. Resolver current descriptors and recursive child descriptors close through finally; failed exact-open checks close the new descriptor.

The snapshot explicitly does not exclude directory replacement/ABA or namespace changes, is non-atomic, and makes no continuous-custody claim. Mandatory quiescent independent parent post-owner inventory remains necessary.
These containment observations cannot establish actual native registry identity, universal future-tool confinement, production configuration qualification, or retrospective UNKNOWN resolution.
qualification: Read-only source and AST review only; no imports, predicate tests, native jobs, model calls or C edits.
reviewed_scope: Descriptor-rooted symlink containment/accounting and FD cleanup only; native model/toolset predicate and parent resource admission require separate qualification.
